description: Fixed-length numeric vector representing one network flow with window context

flow.preprocessing: MinMaxScaler — all values normalized to range [0, 1]

ctx_window.preprocessing: Count-like dims: log1p then MinMaxScaler to [0,1]
ctx_window.definition: ws_* = stats for the flow's src in its 60s window; wd_* = stats for its dst in the same window (build_ctx in exp_m5a_revival.py)

preprocessing_summary: 76 flow dims: MinMax + 11 ctx dims: log1p+MinMax, concatenated
note: v2.0 was 76 dims (legacy autoencoder_v2-256.pt). v3.0 is 87 dims (revived ctx AE). Legacy consumers pinned to v2.0 must stay on legacy/stub_detector.
owner_produces: A (Data & Capture) + B (Detection — ctx builder in exp_m5a_revival.py)
owner_consumes: B (Detection Modeling — RevivedAE in train_m5a_revived.py, served by alert_pipeline.score_window)
